_comment: Weekday: Mon=0. 'nth' = nth weekday of month. Sources compared 2026-10-21 (see 'Pantry table.docx'): pantry sites, Middle Georgia Community Food Bank/county guide, Georgia College, Lemontree, WhyHunger, findhelp. Where sources conflict only the overlap is listed (New Beginnings: Thursday). Nothing here is phone-confirmed yet. Chard Wray: own site says 454 Broad St, most other sources 472. MIA: own site and food bank say 453-2221, Lemontree says 696-0112. Coordinates for Chard Wray, New Beginnings and First Presbyterian come from the places Google Maps resolves (2026-10-21); First Presbyterian was previously a guess about 0.4 mi off. MIA is not found by name on Google Maps, so it keeps Lemontree's coordinates and directions use them directly. 'maps_query' is the text Google resolves to the real place (right label on the route); pantries without it use coordinates. Google's listing for Chard Wray says 454 Broad St, matching the pantry's own site, while the address shown here is 472.
